basic_details.job_title: Odisha Grameen Bank Stock Auditor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Grameen Bank invites Chartered Accountant firms to apply for empanelment as Stock Auditors. The firms will conduct stock audits of the bank. Applications go by registered post only to the General Manager (Inspection), Odisha Grameen Bank, Bhubaneswar. They must reach the bank on or before 31 October 2026, by 5 p.m. Applications sent by email will not be accepted.

age_limit.details: An individual stock auditor must be at least 25 years old at the time of application. For a firm, neither the proprietor nor any of the partners should be below 25 years. At the time of empanelment, the age of the individual applicant or proprietor must not exceed 75 years. For partnership firms, at least one partner should be below 75 years of age at the time of empanelment.

qualification.details: Chartered Accountant firms that meet the following criteria may apply: | The firm of Chartered Accountants (proprietorship/partnership/company) should have at least 5 years' experience. The applicant firm or company should be registered with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. The applicant should have at least 5 years of post-qualification practising experience. At least 2 years of this should be in stock audits in different types of industry or sectors. For firms, the experience of the Managing or Senior partners is considered the experience of the firm. Some valuers may also apply for empanelment as stock auditor for specialised categories. They must be a registered valuer of stocks under section 34AB of the Wealth Tax Act and a fellow or associate member of the Institution of Valuers. The specialisation must be jewellery, precious stones and ornaments, works of art, chemicals, or any such specialised stock. An audit firm with at least one such partner or senior employee is eligible for empanelment as stock auditor for that specialised stock. The applicant individuals or firms, and all partners, must be income tax assessees. The applicant should be an Indian citizen. A stock auditor, proprietor, partner or employee of the audit firm may be an ex-employee of the bank. In that case the auditor or firm becomes eligible only after a cooling period of three years from that employee's date of retirement. | An individual stock auditor must be at least 25 years old at the time of application. content_sections.heading: About Odisha Grameen Bank Stock Audit Empanelment
content_sections.text: Odisha Grameen Bank is a bank with its office at Gandamunda, Khandagiri, Bhubaneswar. The notice is signed by the General Manager, Credit Monitoring Department. It seeks firms that will conduct stock audits of the bank. These audits cover accounts with an overall working capital limit (Fund+Non-Fund) of Rs. 1 crore and above.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Firms must fill in the biodata in Annexure-A (the prescribed format), on the firm's letterhead, and attach the supporting documents. The application goes by registered post only to this address: General Manager (Inspection), Odisha Grameen Bank, At- Gandamunda, P.O.-Khandagiri, Bhubaneswar-751030. The bank must receive the application by 31 October 2026, 5 p.m. Applications received by email will not be accepted. The Annexure-A form is addressed to "The General Manager (CMD), Odisha Grameen Bank, Head Office, Bhubaneswar". All partners or directors must sign the form, and each one's photograph must be fixed on it. The Annexure-A biodata asks for the following details: Name of the firm or company, its constitution and the date it was established Registered or communication address, and contact phone and mobile numbers PAN, TIN and UCN Present activity of the firm or company, and since when Revenue and net profit during the last 3 years Names, educational/professional qualification, phone number, PAN and address of the proprietor, partners or directors (details as per the record of ICAI/RBI) Particulars of registration or affiliation with professional bodies Details of stock audits conducted for banks or FIs over 5 years: name of the bank, year and name of the account (proof of experience to be attached) The form ends with a declaration. It says the information is complete and true, that no adverse material information is concealed, and that the firm accepts the bank's terms and conditions for empanelment of Stock Auditors. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Chartered Accountant firms that meet the following criteria may apply: The firm of Chartered Accountants (proprietorship/partnership/company) should have at least 5 years' experience. The applicant firm or company should be registered with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. The applicant should have at least 5 years of post-qualification practising experience. At least 2 years of this should be in stock audits in different types of industry or sectors. For firms, the experience of the Managing or Senior partners is considered the experience of the firm. Some valuers may also apply for empanelment as stock auditor for specialised categories. They must be a registered valuer of stocks under section 34AB of the Wealth Tax Act and a fellow or associate member of the Institution of Valuers. The specialisation must be jewellery, precious stones and ornaments, works of art, chemicals, or any such specialised stock. An audit firm with at least one such partner or senior employee is eligible for empanelment as stock auditor for that specialised stock. The applicant individuals or firms, and all partners, must be income tax assessees. The applicant should be an Indian citizen. A stock auditor, proprietor, partner or employee of the audit firm may be an ex-employee of the bank. In that case the auditor or firm becomes eligible only after a cooling period of three years from that employee's date of retirement. An individual stock auditor must be at least 25 years old at the time of application. For a firm, neither the proprietor nor any of the partners should be below 25 years. At the time of empanelment, the age of the individual applicant or proprietor must not exceed 75 years. For partnership firms, at least one partner should be below 75 years of age at the time of empanelment. Empanelment with PSBs, FIs, DRT, a High Court or the Supreme Court as a stock auditor is a preferred qualification. It is not mandatory for empanelment. Preference will be given to firms whose partners or staff have an engineering background, experience with the SAP environment, or CISA/DISA, to help with the stock audit. Where the same partner(s) are common to more than one firm, only one of those firms may be considered for empanelment. A statutory or concurrent auditor of a branch, for stock audits of that same branch, even if empanelled. content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Empanelment is for a period of five years. The bank will review the quality of service and performance of the stock auditors annually. Only registered post is accepted. Applications sent by email will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Odisha Grameen Bank Stock Auditor empanelment?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the bank on or before 31 October 2026, by 5 p.m.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for empanelment as Stock Auditor?
faq.answer: Chartered Accountant firms registered with ICAI with at least 5 years' experience may apply. The applicant needs at least 5 years of post-qualification practising experience, including at least 2 years in stock audits.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Stock Auditor empanelment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 25 years at the time of application. At empanelment, the individual applicant or proprietor must not be older than 75 years. For partnership firms, at least one partner should be below 75 years.

faq.question: Q4. What fee does Odisha Grameen Bank pay for a stock audit?
faq.answer: The fee payable is Rs.7,500/- (Rupees Seven thousand Five hundred only). Stock audits cover accounts with an overall working capital limit of Rs. 1 crore and above, and are conducted on a yearly basis.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-A biodata on the firm's letterhead and attach the supporting documents. Send it by registered post only to General Manager (Inspection), Odisha Grameen Bank, At- Gandamunda, P.O.-Khandagiri, Bhubaneswar-751030.

faq.question: Q6. Can I send the application by email?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that applications received through email will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the empanelment period?
faq.answer: Empanelment is for five years. The bank will review the stock auditors' quality of service and performance annually.

faq.question: Q8. Can a former employee of the bank be part of an applicant firm?
faq.answer: Yes, but only after a cooling period of three years from that employee's date of retirement.

faq.question: Q9. Is empanelment with other banks required?
faq.answer: No. Empanelment with PSBs, FIs, DRT, a High Court or the Supreme Court as a stock auditor is preferred, but it is not mandatory.
